disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. SMR developers are pre-revenue with long regulatory timelines; verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

kpis.label: Oklo's Q3 (Nov 6) showed a net loss of $41.7M, narrower than expected, and the stock jumped ~19% to ~$22.93 after a new 52-week low — still down ~68% year to date. Aurora is targeted for 2028-2029, DOE approved the preliminary safety analysis, and the Meta up-to-1.2 GW Ohio agreement is not currently binding

kpis.sub: CEG OVER TWO SESSIONS AFTER MIDTERMS
kpis.label: Nuclear and AI-power names sold off Nov 4-5 after Democrats won Congress (Constellation ~-9%, Vistra -14%), then bounced Nov 6 on a +165K jobs report; Constellation trades near 19.8x forward earnings vs a 26x three-year average and reports Q3 on Nov 9

Centrus Q3 (Nov 4): revenue $55.5M vs $74.9M, adjusted loss of $0.46/share, gross loss of $10.6M; GAAP profit came from a $46.4M warrant gain. DOE's proposed FY2027 budget does not fund continued HALEU cascade operation (~$0.8B of backlog) and DOE does not intend to exercise further HALEU contract options. FY2026 revenue guide $450-500M

NuScale's Q3 (Nov 5) revenue was only ~$281K with $1.9B in cash; the ENTRA1-TVA power purchase agreement is still not signed and would not itself be a module sale. Shares ~$5.04 after a +15% rebound on Nov 6, down ~37% over the month

tiers.label: Operating / Cash-Generating Exposure
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Largest US nuclear fleet operator (55 GW post-Calpine); direct data-center PPAs with Microsoft, Meta, Walmart
rows.watch for: Fell ~9% over the two sessions after the Nov 3 midterm result (Vistra -14%); forward P/E ~19.8x vs a 3-year average of 26x; consensus 2026 EPS $12.21 vs management guidance of $11.50-12.50; Amazon (690 MW, 20 years) and Google contracts plus the Oct 27 conditional DOE loan of up to $5B for uprates support the fleet; Q3 results Mon Nov 9 before the open, Crane restart still targeted for 2027

rows.angle: Major Western uranium producer + Westinghouse stake
rows.watch for: No new company news this week; last reported close $76.91 on Oct 30 (52-week range $73.89-$135.24) after a Q3 adjusted loss of C$2M, production -20% on the Key Lake shutdown and cash cost per pound +62%; CEO says AI/data centres are not the foundation of the thesis, with 28M lb a year contracted through 2030; forward P/E has compressed from 111x in April to ~47x; next test is 2027 guidance in February (price not re-verified this week)

rows.angle: Nuclear components, naval reactors, advanced reactor work
rows.watch for: Q3 (Nov 2): revenue $953.0M (+10%), non-GAAP EPS $1.26 vs $1.00, adjusted EBITDA $179.7M (+19%), free cash flow $150.5M; FY2026 EBITDA guide nudged up to ~$667M and non-GAAP EPS $4.72-4.77; preliminary 2027 outlook is high-single-digit revenue growth; stock fell ~7.8% on Nov 4 amid a notes refinancing offering; Antares TRISO deal (Oct 27) and Army Janus / Prodigy BANR selections add optionality; dividend $0.27 payable Dec 10

rows.angle: Grid equipment + BWRX-300 SMR design via GE Hitachi Nuclear Energy
rows.watch for: Raised its 2026 outlook on Oct 28 with Q3 organic orders +96% to $29B; the nuclear angle (Clinch River BWRX-300 construction permit, Sep 29) remains a small part of a grid/gas-turbine story; also sits in the Energy Storage sleeve — do not double-count (price not re-verified this week)

tiers.label: Pre-Revenue SMR Developers — Speculative
tiers.note: Tiered by maturity/risk — not a ranked buy list.

rows.angle: Fast reactors using recycled waste; Sam Altman-backed; deals directly with AI/data-center customers
rows.watch for: Q3 (Nov 6): revenue $1.86M, net loss $41.7M (narrower than expected), cash $3.13B at Sep 30 after $2.3B raised via ATM in 2026; stock +19% to ~$22.93 after a fresh 52-week low (-13% on Nov 5), still ~-68% year to date; Aurora online targeted 2028-2029, DOE approved the preliminary safety analysis, Meta up-to-1.2 GW Ohio deal not binding; U.S. Forged Rings reserves capacity equal to 27 Aurora modules for 2030-2035; consensus 2026 EPS loss ~$0.98

rows.angle: Only SMR design with NRC formal approval; utility-focused; 6 GW TVA/ENTRA1 collaboration announced
rows.watch for: Q3 (Nov 5): revenue ~$281K vs $8.2M a year earlier, loss $0.11/share (smaller than expected), $1.9B cash and investments; ~$5.04 on Nov 6 (+15%) but down ~37% over the month; the ENTRA1-TVA PPA is still unsigned and a separate ENTRA1 OEM agreement would be needed; Doosan fabrication deal is a manufacturing step, not an order; UBS Sell, Barclays Underweight; consensus revenue only ~$20M in 2026

rows.angle: HALEU enrichment — fuel for advanced reactors
rows.watch for: Q3 (Nov 4): revenue $55.5M (-26%), adjusted loss $0.46/share, gross loss $10.6M; GAAP EPS of $1.41 diluted was flattered by a $46.4M warrant gain; backlog ~$7.0B to 2040 (~$5.4B contingent LEU/HALEU sales) but DOE's FY2027 budget does not fund the HALEU cascade (~$0.8B of backlog) and DOE won't exercise further options; first new centrifuge shipped from Oak Ridge ahead of schedule; FY2026 revenue guide $450-500M; shares reportedly rebounded on Nov 6 (price not verified)

private_watchlist.name: TerraPower
private_watchlist.note: Construction of the first Natrium unit at Kemmerer, Wyoming (345 MWe, up to 500 MWe with storage) has been under way since April 2026; Hyundai E&C was named EPC contractor in August (up to eight Natrium reactors), settling the earlier Bechtel rebid, and a SK Innovation term sheet targets Korea's first Natrium plant. No new dated item this week; the Natrium Kemmerer unit remains under construction.

private_watchlist.name: X-energy
private_watchlist.note: Listed as XE (last verified close $11.54 on Oct 28; price not re-verified this week). The Oct 19 Amazon/AEP 960 MW Indiana plan is evaluation-stage only; TRISO-X president Joel Duling retires Nov 20 and the NRC decision on the 4-unit Long Mott project is expected in H1 2027.

private_watchlist.name: Kairos Power
private_watchlist.note: No new update this week. Google's corporate agreement for a US SMR fleet remains up to 500 MW across 6-7 units, targeting a first commercial Hermes unit by 2030 and full fleet by 2035; the Hermes 2 demonstration plant at Oak Ridge continues construction.

private_watchlist.name: Commonwealth Fusion
private_watchlist.note: Signed a letter of intent for up to $85M from the Commerce CHIPS R&D Office (reported Oct 30) for silicon-carbide magnet power electronics, solid-state RF plasma heating and a SPARC digital twin — one of four LOIs totalling up to $389M. SPARC remains targeted for a 2027 Q>1 run; total capital raised about $4B.

private_watchlist.name: Helion
private_watchlist.note: Its Commerce CHIPS letter of intent for up to $175M (with $50M private matching; Commerce would take a $175M non-voting stake on a definitive award) was reaffirmed in the Oct 30 round of four LOIs. Reports of OpenAI talks for up to 5GW by 2030 sit alongside the Microsoft PPA (50MW by 2029 via the Orion plant).

private_watchlist.name: Holtec Nuclear
private_watchlist.note: No new update this week. The ~$900M Nasdaq listing (HNUC) remains suspended since Sep 16 with no new pricing date; the S-1 stays on file. The underlying business is unchanged: $564M trailing revenue anchored by the Palisades restart and the SMR-300 programme.

bear_case.title: Policy risk surfaced: the midterm sell-off
bear_case.description: After Democrats won Congress, nuclear and AI-power stocks fell for two sessions (Constellation ~-9%, Vistra -14%, Bloom -16%), then rebounded on Nov 6 — a reminder the group trades as high-beta AI/rates exposure. Counter: management argues both parties are pro-nuclear, and a Pew 2025 poll found 59% of Americans back more nuclear plants.

bear_case.title: HALEU's anchor customer is stepping back
bear_case.description: DOE's proposed FY2027 budget does not fund continued HALEU cascade operation (~$0.8B of Centrus's backlog) and DOE doesn't intend to exercise further HALEU contract options; Centrus Q3 revenue fell 26% with a gross loss. Counter: ~$7.0B backlog and the first new centrifuge shipped early.

bear_case.title: Still no signed TVA deal at NuScale
bear_case.description: Q3 revenue was ~$281K, the ENTRA1-TVA PPA remains unsigned, and even once signed it is not a module sale; UBS is at Sell and Barclays at Underweight. Counter: $1.9B cash and a manufacturing contract with Doosan.

bear_case.title: Dilution is the real funding model
bear_case.description: Oklo raised $2.3B via ATM offerings in 2026 and still has an overhang while projecting multi-billion burn; NuScale and Centrus have ATM/offering programmes too. Counter: Oklo's cash rose to $3.13B and funds long-lead work.

bear_case.title: A non-binding MOU is not a customer
bear_case.description: Oklo's up-to-1.2 GW Meta Ohio agreement is explicitly not binding, X-energy's 960 MW Indiana plan has no FID, and zero commercial SMRs operate. Counter: TerraPower is building Natrium and the Clinch River BWRX-300 permit is issued.

bear_case.title: Uranium operators are not immune
bear_case.description: Cameco's Oct 30 Q3 miss (production -20%, cash cost +62%) took it to a fresh low even with long-term uranium near $96 in September. Counter: contracting through 2030 and a Westinghouse stake.

stance.basis: Weights are a share of a hypothetical 100% sleeve for THIS SECTOR only — not a share of your portfolio. Core and Speculative names carry the weight; Watch and Avoid deliberately carry 0% because the point of those groups is that you are not holding them yet.

positions.name: Cameco
positions.note: Long-term uranium near $96 and 28M lb a year contracted through 2030 keep the thesis intact despite the Oct 30 Q3 miss (production -20%, stock $76.91), and forward P/E has compressed from 111x to ~47x.

positions.name: Constellation Energy
positions.note: Down ~9% in two post-midterm sessions to ~19.8x forward earnings (vs 26x average) with Amazon and Google contracts and a conditional $5B DOE uprate loan behind it; Q3 on Nov 9 is the test of $11.50-12.50 guidance.

positions.name: Oklo
positions.note: Cash of $3.13B and a narrower Q3 loss ($41.7M) justify a small option, but revenue was $1.86M, Aurora is 2028-2029 and the Meta Ohio deal is non-binding.

positions.name: BWX Technologies
positions.note: Q3 was solid (revenue +10%, EBITDA guide raised to ~$667M, 2027 high-single-digit growth) but the stock fell ~7.8% on Nov 4 amid a debt refinancing and I have no fresh price to judge valuation, so not yet held.

positions.name: GE Vernova
positions.note: Orders +96% to $29B and a raised outlook are a grid/gas story, with the BWRX-300 a small piece; also sits in the Energy Storage sleeve — don't double-count.

positions.name: X-energy
positions.note: The 960 MW Amazon/AEP Indiana plan is evaluation-stage only, the NRC decision on Long Mott is H1 2027 and the TRISO-X president retires Nov 20, so no position yet.

positions.name: Centrus Energy
positions.note: Q3 revenue fell 26% to $55.5M with a gross loss and an adjusted loss, and DOE's FY2027 budget doesn't fund the HALEU cascade (~$0.8B of backlog) nor further contract options — the research does not support owning it here.

positions.name: NuScale Power
positions.note: Q3 revenue of ~$281K, an unsigned ENTRA1-TVA PPA that would not be a module sale anyway, and UBS Sell / Barclays Underweight — a licence is not a delivered reactor.
